stem.text: Light of wavelength $\lambda$ is incident normally on two narrow slits $\text{S}_1$ and $\text{S}_2$, a small distance apart. Bright and dark fringes are observed on a screen a long distance away from the slits.

stem.alt: Ray diagram of light of wavelength λ incident normally on two slits S1 and S2, with rays converging on point P on a screen; labelled light, wavelength λ, screen and P.

stem.text: The $n$th **dark** fringe from the central bright fringe is observed at point P on the screen.
Which equation is correct for all positive values of $n$?
